Belveth.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. Buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder to reduce healing from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet. Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet's true damage cannot be blocked by resistances, so build health to withstand it.
Belveth.teamfight: When your allies can follow up immediately, move behind Bel'Veth and kick her toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. If your allies have not engaged yet, save Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to knock away an opponent who dives in, and plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike before engaging. If an ally dies and leaves Void Coral, back off before Bel'Veth can claim it, and delay the team fight while her transformation is active.
Belveth.combo: After hitting Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away with a basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, and another basic attack, then engage with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If Bel'Veth escapes with Q Void Surge or R Endless Banquet, use Lee Sin E Cripple's slow. If Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is spinning, deal your heavy damage after it ends. When your allies can follow up, kick Bel'Veth toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.
Belveth.escape: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below to the side to avoid its crowd control and deny her the chance to reduce Bel'Veth Q Void Surge's cooldown, then engage. Check which direction Bel'Veth Q Void Surge went, and close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave or Lee Sin W Safeguard before the dash in that direction comes back up, then use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Bel'Veth may still have another mobility option, so do not overcommit based on just one dash being down.
Belveth.fight: Fight Bel'Veth early, before she stacks up, and weave basic attacks between Lee Sin's abilities to use Lee Sin P Flurry's attack speed and energy restoration. After Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends, chip away at her health to make the most of Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike's missing-health damage. If you dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below to the side, close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave or Lee Sin W Safeguard.
Belveth.laning: After your first two or three camps, track Bel'Veth's route and invade or look for an encounter to steal large monsters and camps. When entering the enemy jungle, save Lee Sin W Safeguard for your escape. When ganking, approach beside the wave so you can hit Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, which minions block.
Belveth.phase: In the mid game, use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to create fights your allies can follow up on, and be wary of taking the same kind of duel as Bel'Veth's stacks grow. Later, Lee Sin has a harder time bursting Bel'Veth alone, so focus on setting up fights for your allied damage dealers.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below slows and knocks you up, and also reduces the cooldown of Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, so dodge to the side when she approaches. While Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is spinning, her damage taken is greatly reduced, so save Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike until it ends. Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet provides healing and true damage, so do not let a fight drag on while she is transformed.

Vi.fight: Dodge Vi Q Vault Breaker or bait it out, then close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and W Safeguard. Weave basic attacks between Lee Sin’s abilities, and keep the trade short by using Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike after chipping away at her health. Don’t trade for long enough to let Vi W Denting Blows stack up.
Vi.teamfight: Vi R Cease and Desist follows its target to the end, so move together and don’t let your backline carries wander out of vision alone. Before engaging, make sure your team can follow up immediately and plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Q Resonating Strike.
Vi.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Vi Q Vault Breaker, W Denting Blows, and E Relentless Force. Vi W Denting Blows deals damage based on maximum health and reduces armor, so avoid relying on stacking health alone. Attack speed reduction can also help reduce the damage from Vi’s basic attacks.
Vi.combo: After dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker, attack in this order: Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave → basic attack → Lee Sin E Tempest → basic attack → Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If Vi Q Vault Breaker is still available, use Lee Sin E Cripple’s slow after her dash. Use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage when you can kick Vi toward your team.
Vi.escape: The opening to engage with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or W Safeguard comes right after you bait out Vi Q Vault Breaker. If Vi uses Vi R Cease and Desist, wait until she lands and the knock-up ends, then knock her away with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
Vi.laning: Use Lee Sin’s early jungle dueling advantage to look for a chance to disrupt Vi’s route after your first two or three camps. Save Lee Sin W Safeguard to escape when entering the enemy jungle.
Vi.phase: Early on, Lee Sin is strong in jungle duels, so take control after dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker. Later, Lee Sin has trouble killing enemies alone, so set up fights where your carries can attack.
Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage as it charges, so move back or sideways to dodge when you see her charging stance. Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor with repeated hits, so don’t keep trading for long. Don’t use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage while Vi is charging at you with Vi R Cease and Desist; wait until she lands and her knock-up ends.

Amumu.teamfight: While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, avoid grouping with allies or fighting in narrow passages. Make him use it before starting a fight, and use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to kick a target toward your allies only when they can follow up immediately. If your allies can’t engage yet, save Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to knock away an enemy who dives into your backline.
Amumu.watch: Amumu Q Bandage Toss stops at the first target, so dodge it by keeping a minion or jungle monster between you and Amumu. Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns in an area around him, so keep your distance before he closes in and avoid grouping with your allies. Amumu W Despair deals continuous damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stay near him for long.
Amumu.build: Amumu E Tantrum reduces physical damage taken, so consider armor penetration first. Build magic resistance against Amumu W Despair, and avoid options that only add a large amount of health.
Amumu.combo: After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, lower the target’s health with a basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, then another basic attack before closing in with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Amumu.escape: Engage while Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so close in with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and Q Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard, then use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage. Before going in, plan an exit route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Amumu.fight: After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, don’t dash in right away. Lower the target’s health with basic attacks and Lee Sin E Tempest, then use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike, which deals more damage based on the target’s missing health. Weave basic attacks between abilities to make use of Lee Sin P Flurry’s attack speed and energy restoration.
Amumu.laning: When ganking, approach from beside the wave so minions don’t block Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, and move behind minions with Amumu Q Bandage Toss in mind. Save Lee Sin W Safeguard as an escape when entering deep into the enemy jungle.
Amumu.phase: In the late game, Lee Sin should set up fights for allies with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage rather than trying to kill enemies alone.

Elise.teamfight: When your allies can follow up immediately, kick one enemy in the backline, including Elise, toward your allies with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage. If your allies haven’t engaged yet, save Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to knock away an enemy who dives into your backline. Before engaging, plan an exit route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Elise.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, but Elise will also try to build an advantage with ganks, so look for chances to fight after the first two or three camps without giving up a kill. Once Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage is available in the mid game, kick an enemy toward your allies in a lane where they can follow up. In the late game, Lee Sin has trouble killing enemies alone, so set up fights for your scaling allies.
Elise.laning: In the early game, keep ample vision to guard against Elise’s ganks, and don’t push the lane recklessly when she’s out of sight. When ganking, approach beside the wave so minions don’t block Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave. Save Lee Sin W Safeguard to escape when entering the enemy jungle.
Elise.build: To reduce healing from Elise P Spider Queen, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Build magic resistance first against Elise’s main ability damage, and also get armor to account for her basic attack damage.
Elise.combo: After dodging Elise E Cocoon, land Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and attack in this order: basic attack → Lee Sin E Tempest → basic attack → Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If Elise rises with E Rappel, wait for her to land and look for a chance to hit Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave.
Elise.escape: The chance to engage comes right after both Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down. If Elise in R Spider Form has also used Q Venomous Bite, close the distance with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard, then kick her toward your allies with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage once close.
Elise.fight: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so look for a fight when you’ve dodged Elise E Cocoon or Elise E Rappel is down. Weave basic attacks between abilities to use Lee Sin P Flurry’s attack speed increase and energy restoration. Lower Elise’s health first and use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike close to the finish to increase its damage.
Elise.watch: Watch out for Elise Q Neurotoxin in human form at full health, and for her finishing attack after health drops and she changes into R Spider Form. When you see her transform, block the damage with Lee Sin W Safeguard or move away to create distance.

Hecarim.escape: Do not engage just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down. Look for a window before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows is available again, close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard, then kick Hecarim toward your allies with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows cannot hit multiple people. If Hecarim reaches your back line, knock him back with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage; only kick him toward your allies when they can follow up immediately.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge gains damage and knockback based on how far he runs, so if he turns away and starts running, assume he is building distance and move toward your allies. While Hecarim W Spirit of Dread is active, he heals from damage dealt to nearby enemies, so do not fight him for long; retreat beyond its range, then fight again. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear multiple enemies, so spread out from your allies.
Hecarim.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge. To reduce the healing from Hecarim W Spirit of Dread, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Hecarim.combo: After hitting Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away with basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, basic attack, then close in with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. Use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to kick Hecarim toward your allies when they can follow up.
Hecarim.fight: Use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike to finish Hecarim after chipping away at his health.
Hecarim.laning: After your first two or three camps, use Lee Sin’s early advantage to disrupt Hecarim’s jungle route or gank a lane. Save Lee Sin W Safeguard as an escape when entering the enemy jungle.
Hecarim.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early jungle duels, so turn your advantage into kills or a jungle route lead after your first two or three camps. Late, rather than trying to burst Hecarim alone, use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to stop his engage and create room for your scaled allied damage dealers to fight.

Karthus.laning: Enter from beside the wave so minions do not block Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, and save Lee Sin W Safeguard as an escape when entering the enemy jungle.
Karthus.teamfight: Clear the front line before Karthus enters the range of Karthus E Defile, and if you kill Karthus, move away immediately to avoid the attacks from Karthus P Death Defied. Use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to send an enemy toward your allies only when they can follow up immediately; otherwise, use it to knock back an enemy who has entered your back line.
Karthus.build: Karthus deals magic damage, so build magic resistance rather than armor. However, securing movement speed comes first so you can dodge Karthus W Wall of Pain and quickly leave the area of Karthus E Defile.
Karthus.combo: After hitting Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away with basic attack → Lee Sin E Tempest → basic attack, then close in with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage when a route opens that lets you avoid Karthus W Wall of Pain. If you use both Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and Lee Sin W Safeguard to engage, you have no way out, so plan a route away from his corpse or the area of Karthus E Defile first.
Karthus.fight: Karthus cannot create distance on his own, so hit Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave along a route that avoids Karthus W Wall of Pain, or close the gap with Lee Sin W Safeguard. Once on him, weave in basic attacks between abilities, chip away at his health, then finish with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Karthus.phase: Late, use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to set up a target for your allies to attack instead of trying to kill enemies alone.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals more damage when it hits you alone, so watch its marked blast area and walk out of it. When Karthus W Wall of Pain is placed, go around the wall to avoid the slow and reduced magic resistance. After killing him, move away from his corpse immediately to avoid the follow-up attacks from Karthus P Death Defied.

MasterYi.combo: Right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, attack in this order: Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave → basic attack → Lee Sin E Tempest → basic attack → Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If Master Yi R Highlander is active, don't rely on the slow from Lee Sin E Cripple; use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage from an angle that kicks him toward your allies. If Master Yi uses Master Yi W Meditate, interrupt him with the Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage you saved.
MasterYi.laning: After the first two or three jungle camps, disrupt Master Yi's route or take early objectives to slow his growth. When intervening in a lane, aim Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave from the side so minions don't block it. Keep Lee Sin W Safeguard available to escape when entering the enemy jungle.
MasterYi.phase: Early on, Lee Sin is strong at dueling and intervening, while Master Yi is weak in the jungle and at ganking, so don't delay taking early advantages and objectives. In the late game, Master Yi gets stronger and Lee Sin has a hard time catching opponents alone, so focus on protecting allies or kicking Master Yi toward your team.
MasterYi.teamfight: Wait for Master Yi to land after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, then use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to kick him toward your allies or away from your back line. Watch for Master Yi W Meditate so you can time Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to interrupt it. When Master Yi participates in a takedown, he can quickly close in on his next target, so respond together and don't let an ally get caught alone.
MasterYi.build: If the healing from Master Yi W Meditate is difficult to deal with, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Attack speed reduction can also help delay Master Yi's basic attacks and how soon Master Yi Q Alpha Strike can be used again.
MasterYi.escape: The moment Master Yi lands after using Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is your chance to engage with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard. Before using Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage, check that your allies are positioned to follow up. Before going in, also plan an escape route toward your allies with Lee Sin W Safeguard.
MasterYi.fight: If you encounter Master Yi in the jungle early, use Lee Sin's dueling advantage to fight him. Bait out Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, then close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will when he lands. Use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike close to the finish, after chipping away with basic attacks and Lee Sin E Tempest, and weave in basic attacks between abilities to make use of Lee Sin P Flurry.
MasterYi.watch: While Master Yi uses Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, he can't be targeted, so save Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage until he lands. When Master Yi E Wuju Style is active, his basic attacks deal additional true damage, and slows don't work while Master Yi R Highlander is active, so don't stay in a prolonged fight.

Nocturne.watch: If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, Nocturne can approach quickly along its trail, so do not run in a straight line; angle toward your allies or a turret. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, create distance to break the fear tether. Do not use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage first while Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is available.
Nocturne.build: Buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder to reduce healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades. Prioritize armor against Nocturne's main damage.
Nocturne.combo: After hitting Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, deal damage with a basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, and another basic attack, then close in on the weakened Nocturne with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Nocturne.escape: Save Lee Sin W Safeguard for Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, and create distance to break the fear tether if it connects.
Nocturne.fight: Weave basic attacks between abilities to maintain energy and chip away at his health, then use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike as a finisher.
Nocturne.laning: Use Lee Sin's early dueling advantage to disrupt Nocturne's route or make a lane play after your first two or three camps. Maintain vision at Nocturne's jungle entrances and in the river, and save Lee Sin W Safeguard for your escape when entering the enemy jungle.
Nocturne.phase: Early on, Lee Sin is strong at jungle duels and invading, so gain an advantage after your first two or three camps. Later, use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to peel enemies away and set up fights for your allied damage dealers instead of trying to kill opponents alone.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, move toward your allies to avoid being isolated. If Nocturne dives your back line, remove Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness first, then knock him away with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. When kicking an opponent toward your allies, make sure they can follow up immediately.

Rammus.teamfight: If Rammus rushes in with Rammus Q Powerball, move out of the expanded range of Rammus R Soaring Slam and leave its landing area. Dive the backline and use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to send an enemy toward your team only when they can follow up immediately. If your team hasn’t engaged yet, save Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to knock away an enemy who dives in.
Rammus.laning: Use your early jungle dueling advantage to disrupt Rammus’s route or gank a lane after your first two or three camps. When ganking, approach from beside the wave so minions don’t block Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave. Save Lee Sin W Safeguard to escape when entering the enemy jungle.
Rammus.phase: Early on, use Lee Sin’s strong jungle dueling to pressure Rammus’s route. Later, don’t try to burst Rammus alone; set up fights where your carries can attack.
Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. If you must attack Rammus while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, consider percentage penetration over flat penetration.
Rammus.combo: After Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends, attack in this order: Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave → basic attack → Lee Sin E Tempest → basic attack → Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If Rammus escapes with Rammus R Soaring Slam, use the slow from Lee Sin E Cripple afterward. If your team can follow up, move behind Rammus and kick him toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
Rammus.escape: Engage after Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is also down to reduce the risk of being taunted.
Rammus.fight: Focus your damage immediately after Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends. After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away with basic attacks and Lee Sin E Tempest, then use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike late, when its damage is increased by his missing health. While Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, don’t hit him with the rapid basic attacks from Lee Sin P Flurry.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, put minions between you and him. Dodge Rammus R Soaring Slam, which follows at increased movement speed, by giving its predicted area a wide berth. The landing area of Rammus R Soaring Slam remains slowed, so leave it immediately. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is point-and-click and can’t be dodged, so fight outside its range. When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, his armor rises and basic attacks against him trigger reflected damage, so stop attacking.

Sejuani.combo: After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away with a basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, and another basic attack, then close in with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. After Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, slow her with Lee Sin E Cripple. If your team can follow up, kick Sejuani toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage. Don’t delay Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike so long that you miss the chance to recast it.
Sejuani.teamfight: When your team can follow up immediately, use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to send an enemy toward them. If your team hasn’t engaged yet, save Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to knock away an enemy who dives your backline. Before engaging, plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike so you don’t stay locked down by Sejuani’s crowd control.
Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first against damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North, Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, and Sejuani E Permafrost. Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath deals physical damage, so magic resistance alone won’t block it. Sejuani P Fury of the North deals damage based on maximum health, so be cautious about relying on stacking health alone.
Sejuani.escape: The opening to engage is right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down. Back away first if Sejuani E Permafrost stacks are building or you’re at risk of being hit by Sejuani R Glacial Prison, then close in again from a safe angle with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave or Lee Sin W Safeguard. Before engaging, plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard.
Sejuani.fight: Early on, use Lee Sin P Flurry by weaving basic attacks between abilities. While Sejuani’s Frost Armor is active, her defenses are high and she is immune to slows, so deal damage first and slow her with Lee Sin E Cripple after the armor breaks. Use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike to finish her after chipping away at her health.
Sejuani.laning: Use your early jungle priority to disrupt Sejuani’s route after your first two or three camps, or take camps and objectives when the enemy jungler is on the other side of the map. Play to delay Sejuani’s item timings before she grows tanky. Save Lee Sin W Safeguard to escape when entering the enemy jungle.
Sejuani.phase: Early on, use Lee Sin’s strong jungle dueling to take control and disrupt Sejuani’s farming and objective control. Once Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage is available, look for chances to kick Sejuani toward your team from lanes where they can follow up. Later, instead of trying to kill her alone, set up fights where your carries can deal damage.
Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault dashes in and knocks up, while Sejuani R Glacial Prison slows and stuns in an area. When you see either cast coming, move sideways to dodge. If Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath hits you with its first strike, get out of range before the second. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks from basic attacks by nearby allied melee champions too, so back away as the stacks build.

Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out from your team so multiple allies aren't hit together by Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent’s path and the area damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and Shyvana E Molten Burst. After Shyvana lands, kick her toward your team with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage or knock her away from your backline. When engaging, plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Shyvana.build: Buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder to reduce healing from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis. Build magic resistance first against magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Armor helps against her basic attacks’ physical damage, but resistance can’t block the true damage from Shyvana Q Emberstrike.
Shyvana.combo: Attack in this order: Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave → basic attack → Lee Sin E Tempest → basic attack → Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If your team can follow up, get behind Shyvana with Lee Sin W Safeguard and kick her toward your team with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
Shyvana.escape: A good window to engage is when Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is unavailable. If Shyvana’s Fury bar is empty, pressure her by closing the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave or Lee Sin W Safeguard. If Shyvana engages first with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, wait until she lands, then lock her down with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana with duels and invades early, when Shyvana P Scalemail has few stacks. After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away with basic attacks and Lee Sin E Tempest, then finish with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike, which deals more damage based on her missing health. Weave basic attacks between abilities to use Lee Sin P Flurry’s attack speed increase and energy restoration.
Shyvana.laning: After your first two or three camps, look for a chance to disrupt Shyvana’s jungle route and steal camps. Take objectives early too, to prevent her from building stacks in the early game. Save Lee Sin W Safeguard to escape when venturing deep into the enemy jungle.
Shyvana.phase: Early on, Lee Sin is strong in jungle duels and invades, while Shyvana is weak with few stacks of Shyvana P Scalemail. In the mid game, watch Shyvana’s Fury bar and pressure her or start objectives when it’s empty. Later, Shyvana’s permanent stacks put Lee Sin at a disadvantage, so instead of trying to kill her alone, set up fights for your team with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana Q Emberstrike empowers her basic attack to deal damage based on maximum health and true damage. In close fights while Shyvana W Inferno Aegis is active, watch out for its shield and healing too. Shyvana is unstoppable while flying with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, so use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage after she lands.

Brand.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to prevent Brand E Conflagration and R Pyroclasm from spreading, and don’t stand beside an ally who is burning. If your allies can follow up immediately, kick Brand toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage. If follow-up is difficult, save Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to knock away an enemy who engages on your allies, and plan an exit route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike before engaging.
Brand.build: Brand’s main damage is magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your maximum health, so consider movement speed to move out of telegraphed areas instead of choosing an option that only adds a large amount of health.
Brand.combo: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, land Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, then lower his health with a basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, and another basic attack. Follow with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike, and slow Brand with Lee Sin E Cripple if he runs. After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, add more damage before recasting it, but don’t miss the window to recast.
Brand.escape: The moment after Brand W Pillar of Flame goes down is your chance to engage. If you don’t have Blaze on you, Brand Q Sear won’t stun you, so close in with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard. If Blaze is on you, dodge Brand Q Sear before engaging.
Brand.fight: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and you don’t have Blaze on you, close in with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will. Once close, weave basic attacks between abilities to use Lee Sin P Flurry, lower his health, then finish with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Brand.laning: When ganking, approach beside the wave so it’s easier to land Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, which minions can block. Keep your distance from the wave near minions Brand has set ablaze, since Brand E Conflagration can spread from them. Save Lee Sin W Safeguard for an escape when going deep into the enemy jungle.
Brand.phase: Lee Sin is strong at early jungle duels and ganks, so look for openings when Brand’s poke abilities are down during this phase. In the mid game, when kicking Brand toward your allies with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage, check that they can follow up right away. In the late game, use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to isolate an enemy or knock away one who dives into your allies instead of trying to kill enemies alone.
Brand.watch: After Brand P Blaze is applied, Brand Q Sear stuns you if it hits, so while Blaze is on you, move out of the projectile’s path or dodge behind minions. Dodging Brand W Pillar of Flame first also makes it easier to avoid attacks that build Blaze stacks. When you see Brand R Pyroclasm, spread out from your allies to avoid its bounces.

Gragas.laning: Use your early strength to disrupt the enemy jungle route or gank a lane after your first two or three camps. Approach around the spot where Gragas Q Barrel Roll was placed, and enter from beside the wave so minions do not block Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave. Save Lee Sin W Safeguard as an escape when entering deep into the enemy jungle.
Gragas.teamfight: Do not leave your back line exposed alone to Gragas E Body Slam in narrow passages or brush without vision. When your allies can follow up immediately, kick a target toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage; otherwise, use it to knock back an enemy who dives in. Before engaging, plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Gragas.build: To reduce the healing from Gragas P Happy Hour, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Add penetration against Gragas’s high armor, and build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand his magic damage. Be wary of stacking only health, since Gragas W Drunken Rage deals damage based on maximum health.
Gragas.combo: When Gragas E Body Slam is down, hit Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and chip away with basic attack → Lee Sin E Tempest → basic attack. Then close in with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike, and slow Gragas with Lee Sin E Cripple when he tries to escape. If your allies can follow up, get behind Gragas and kick him toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
Gragas.escape: Gragas E Body Slam both moves him and knocks you up, so the moment after you make him use it is your window to engage. Close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will, but do not chase so deep that Gragas can use E Body Slam again.
Gragas.fight: When you see Gragas W Drunken Rage’s drinking animation, deal your heavy damage after its damage reduction ends. Close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will immediately after baiting out Gragas E Body Slam. Weave in basic attacks empowered by Lee Sin P Flurry between abilities, and use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike after his health is chipped down.
Gragas.phase: Early, use Lee Sin’s strength in jungle duels to disrupt Gragas’s route and build an advantage. In mid-game objective fights, watch for Gragas’s burst and ability to disrupt your formation, and look for a chance to use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to set up a target for your allies. Late, Lee Sin has trouble bursting enemies alone, so create opportunities for your scaled allies to attack.
Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its radius before it explodes. If you also get hit by Gragas E Body Slam near the barrel, the damage and crowd control stack, so do not stand on the barrel within E range. When Gragas has R Explosive Cask available, do not stand with your back to an enemy turret or the enemy team.

Nunu.teamfight: When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, interrupt the channel with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage or leave its area. If your allies can follow up immediately, kick Nunu & Willump or another opponent toward your team with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. If your allies can't engage yet, save Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to push away an opponent who dives in.
Nunu.build: To reduce the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Build magic resistance against Nunu & Willump's primary damage, and get tenacity to deal with crowd control.
Nunu.combo: Attack in this order: Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave → basic attack → Lee Sin E Tempest → basic attack → Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. When Nunu & Willump tries to escape, use the slow from Lee Sin E Cripple. If you can get behind Nunu & Willump and an ally can follow up, kick them toward your ally with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.
Nunu.escape: After dodging the knockup from Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and the root from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave or Lee Sin W Safeguard. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance, so if you get an opportunity to engage, follow up with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Before going in, also plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Nunu.fight: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so fight Nunu & Willump when you can reduce their healing. Use basic attacks empowered by Lee Sin P Flurry between abilities to deal damage and recover energy. After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away with basic attacks and Lee Sin E Tempest, then close in with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike, which deals more damage based on missing health.
Nunu.laning: Watch for Nunu & Willump to return after ganking once, possibly by passing through the river crab. Use Lee Sin's early advantage after the first two or three camps to disrupt the enemy jungle route or intervene in a lane, but keep Lee Sin W Safeguard available when going deep into the enemy jungle.
Nunu.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early jungle duels and invades, so look for an advantage after the first two or three camps. In the late game, Lee Sin has a hard time taking down opponents alone, so focus on setting up opportunities for your allied damage dealers to attack.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! knocks you up and rolls in from far away, so move toward the incoming snowball and escape through the path Nunu & Willump came from instead of running backward. If hit by Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, use Lee Sin W Safeguard to leave the area before the delayed root. The slow from Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero grows stronger within its range, so leave immediately or interrupt the channel with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.

RekSai.laning: After your first two or three camps, track Rek’Sai’s route and look for an early duel or invade. Don’t give up kills to Rek’Sai’s early and mid-game ganks: avoid pushing lanes too far and don’t walk alone through areas without vision. Walk over visible Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel entrances to destroy them, and save Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will to escape when entering the enemy jungle.
RekSai.phase: Early on, Lee Sin is strong in jungle duels, so disrupt Rek’Sai’s route first and gain an advantage. Rek’Sai also tries to build an advantage through early and mid-game ganks, so don’t give up kills. Once Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage is available in the mid game, gank lanes where your team can follow up. Later, Lee Sin struggles to burst opponents alone, so set up fights where your carries can deal damage.
RekSai.teamfight: Engage with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will only when your team can follow up immediately, then use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to kick an enemy toward them. If your team can’t engage yet, save Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to knock away Rek’Sai when she dives your backline. Before engaging, plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will or Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike.
RekSai.build: Buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder to reduce healing from Rek’Sai P Fury of the Xer’Sai. Build armor first against physical damage from Rek’Sai Q Queen’s Wrath / Prey Seeker and other abilities. Resistances don’t reduce the true damage from Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek’Sai R Void Rush scales with maximum health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone.
RekSai.combo: When using Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage, kick the target in a direction your allies can follow up on.
RekSai.escape: The opening to engage comes after dodging the knock-up from Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. If only Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can still escape with Rek’Sai R Void Rush, so wait until she can’t use that dash either. Then close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will and lock her down with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
RekSai.fight: Use Lee Sin’s early dueling advantage, but fight only after dodging the knock-up from Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. If Rek’Sai Burrows to heal, keep up the pressure and don’t give her space.
RekSai.watch: When Rek’Sai is Burrowed, watch for the knock-up when Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow surfaces, and move toward open ground instead of walls or narrow paths. As she surfaces, reposition with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will to avoid the knock-up. After Rek’Sai damages you, stay close to allies because Rek’Sai R Void Rush can follow up.

Skarner.teamfight: Engage only when your allies can follow up immediately, and use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to kick the target toward them. If your allies have not engaged yet, save Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to knock away Skarner when he dives your back line. Be mindful of Skarner R Impale's short range and the direction it will drag you. Before engaging, plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will or Q Resonating Strike.
Skarner.build: First decide whether you need a way to break Skarner R Impale's suppression. If so, consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. Prioritize magic resistance against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale.
Skarner.combo: When Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, hit Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and chip away with a basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, and another basic attack. Follow with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike, and slow Skarner with Lee Sin E Cripple if he runs. If your allies can follow up immediately, get behind Skarner and kick him toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.
Skarner.escape: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is his main mobility tool, so right after he uses it is your chance to engage with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or W Safeguard / Iron Will.
Skarner.fight: Bait out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, then close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or W Safeguard / Iron Will. Weave basic attacks between abilities to use Lee Sin P Flurry's attack speed and energy restoration, and use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike after Skarner has taken damage. Slow Skarner with Lee Sin E Cripple when he backs away again.
Skarner.laning: Use your early jungle dueling advantage to disrupt Skarner's route after your first two or three camps, or take camps and make a lane play while Skarner is occupied on the other side. Secure early jungle control and objectives to delay Skarner's tank items. When going deep into the enemy jungle, save Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will for your escape.
Skarner.phase: Early on, Lee Sin is strong at jungle duels and invading, so disrupt Skarner's growth and deny him objectives. In the mid game, use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to kick a target your allies can follow up on toward them. Later, Skarner gains damage and survivability from tank items while Lee Sin's share of the damage falls, so set up fights for your allied damage dealers instead of trying to kill Skarner alone.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain and stuns you when he slams you into a wall, so do not stand with your back to one. Skarner R Impale suppresses you at short range and drags you through terrain, so keep your distance from Skarner and do not stand near the edge of an objective pit. Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval's empowered basic attacks deal damage based on your maximum health, so do not stay in an extended fight with him.

Viego.laning: Disrupt the enemy jungler's route after your first two or three camps, or look for chances to take camps and make a lane play while the enemy jungler is occupied on the other side. Do not push the lane toward the visible direction of Viego E Harrowed Path; avoid that path and go around it. When entering the enemy jungle, save Lee Sin W Safeguard for your escape.
Viego.teamfight: When your allies can follow up immediately, kick Viego toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. If your allies cannot engage yet, save the ability to knock away Viego when he dives in. If Viego kills an ally, do not continue fighting where they fell; kick Viego away from that spot to prevent him from possessing the body.
Viego.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King sustain make the duel drag on, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Viego.combo: Chip away and finish with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave → basic attack → Lee Sin E Tempest → basic attack → Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If Viego escapes with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker, use Lee Sin E Cripple's slow to stick to him. When you need to kick Viego toward your allies, hit Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, move behind him, then use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.
Viego.escape: Engage after Viego W Spectral Maw's stun and dash are down. If Viego R Heartbreaker is also down, close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and Q Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard, then lock him down with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. If only one is down, the other mobility spell can still let him escape, so do not rush in.
Viego.fight: Use your early jungle dueling advantage, but do not immediately follow a hit from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. Weave basic attacks empowered by Lee Sin P Flurry between abilities to chip away, and use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike when Viego has lost more health. If Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker is still available, plan your means of pursuing him before going in.
Viego.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early jungle duels, so turn your advantage after the first two or three camps into kills or lane plays. Later, Lee Sin has a harder time bursting opponents alone, so focus on setting up fights for your allied damage dealers.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it is charged, so dodge to the side when you see him charging. Use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage when you need to interrupt him. If Viego E Harrowed Path covers terrain, Viego may be camouflaged there, so avoid that path. When your health is low, fall back because you may be targeted by Viego R Heartbreaker.

Briar.laning: Check Briar’s path after the first two or three camps, then steal camps or gank while the enemy jungler is occupied on the other side. When ganking, approach beside the wave so minions don’t block Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave. Keep allies from lingering in the middle of a lane without vision, and save Lee Sin W Safeguard when entering the enemy jungle.
Briar.watch: Keep your distance from Briar Q Head Rush to avoid its stun and resistance reduction. When Briar starts channeling E Chilling Scream, interrupt it with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage, and avoid fighting with a wall at your back. If hit by Briar R Certain Death’s bloodstone, move toward your allies and fight back together.
Briar.escape: Don’t engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down; check Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and R Certain Death too. In particular, while Briar R Certain Death is still down, close the distance with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or W Safeguard during the window after Briar E Chilling Scream’s stun is down. Then kick her toward your allies with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
Briar.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Briar P Crimson Curse, Q Head Rush, and W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If healing makes the duel drag on, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Briar.combo: After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, lower Briar’s health with a basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, then another basic attack before using Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If Briar channels E Chilling Scream, interrupt it with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage and kick her toward your allies.
Briar.fight: If you encounter Briar in the early jungle, use Lee Sin’s dueling strength to lower her health and delay her next move. Weave basic attacks between abilities to use Lee Sin P Flurry, then follow her with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike after her health has been reduced. Keep Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack’s healing in mind and don’t let the fight drag on.
Briar.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early jungle duels, but watch out for Briar’s early ganks too. In the mid game, use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to kick Briar toward your allies and create a fight they can join. In the late game, Lee Sin has trouble killing enemies alone, so shift to protecting your allied damage dealers.
Briar.teamfight: When Briar dives in with W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, have your frontline stay close to protect your backline damage dealers. Interrupt Briar E Chilling Scream’s channel with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage, or knock her away when she dives into the backline. Position so the frontline can take Briar R Certain Death’s bloodstone first, and when you engage as Lee Sin, check that allies can follow up immediately and that you have an exit route.

Poppy.escape: The moment after Poppy uses Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the gap. However, if Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don't dash in with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike or W Safeguard; wait for it to end. If things get dangerous, use the Lee Sin W Safeguard you saved to move to a ward toward your allies.
Poppy.teamfight: While Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, delay Lee Sin's dash engage. When your allies can follow up immediately, kick a target toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage; if they can't engage yet, save R to push away an opponent who dives into your back line. Before engaging, plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Q Resonating Strike.
Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy's primary damage. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid relying on a large amount of health alone.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, land Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and attack in this order: basic attack → E Tempest → basic attack → Q Resonating Strike. If Poppy escapes with Poppy E Heroic Charge, follow with the slow from Lee Sin E Cripple. When using Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage, kick Poppy in a direction your allies can follow up on.
Poppy.fight: Engage after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and right after Poppy uses Poppy E Heroic Charge. After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away with basic attacks between abilities, and use Q Resonating Strike close to the finish because its damage increases based on missing health. Don't stay in the area from Poppy Q Hammer Shock.
Poppy.laning: When ganking, approach from the side of the wave because minions block Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave. Move toward open space so Poppy E Heroic Charge can't push you into a wall. If you can step on Poppy's dropped buckler before she retrieves it, deny her shield.
Poppy.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early jungle duels, so look for an opportunity to disrupt Poppy's route after the first two or three camps. In the late game, Lee Sin has a hard time taking down opponents alone, so focus on setting up favorable fights for your allies.
Poppy.watch: While Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don't dash in with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike or W Safeguard. If Poppy E Heroic Charge pushes you into a wall, you'll be stunned, so stay in open space. If hit by Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the area before the second hit. When you see Poppy charging Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, move sideways out of her front.

Shaco.escape: The opening to engage with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and Lee Sin W Safeguard comes right after Shaco uses Shaco Q Deceive. Clear Shaco W Jack In The Box in areas without vision before going in so its fear doesn’t interrupt your engage. If Shaco dives onto Lee Sin, focus him with your allies while he can’t immediately use Shaco Q Deceive again.
Shaco.phase: Early on, Lee Sin is strong in jungle duels, but Shaco also looks for advantages through ganks and invades, so keep vision up and don’t give up kills. In the mid game, look for chances to kick Shaco toward your team with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage. Later, Shaco is weaker in isolated fights and Lee Sin has trouble bursting enemies alone, so focus on setting up fights where your team can attack.
Shaco.teamfight: When Shaco uses Shaco Q Deceive to engage and becomes visible, focus him immediately with your team. Don’t waste damage on Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone; identify the real Shaco by watching health bar reactions, and move away from the explosion and box when the clone dies. Use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to kick Shaco toward your team only when they can follow up immediately; otherwise, save it to knock away an enemy diving your team.
Shaco.watch: Watch out for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in brush where you have no vision and around objectives. If Shaco Q Deceive gets behind you, his empowered basic attack is dangerous, so stand with your back to a wall or face your allies when he’s nearby. Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone explodes and leaves a box when it dies, so move away from where it falls.
Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first against Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Get enough health to avoid the low-health range where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage. Before entering areas without vision, clear boxes with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens, and consider movement speed to escape their trigger radius.
Shaco.combo: After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away in this order: basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, basic attack, then use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If your team can follow up, get behind Shaco and kick him toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
Shaco.fight: Right after Shaco Q Deceive is down, close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave or Lee Sin W Safeguard. Weave basic attacks between abilities to use Lee Sin P Flurry’s attack speed and energy restoration. After chipping away at Shaco’s health, follow him with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike, then slow him with Lee Sin E Cripple if he tries to escape.
Shaco.laning: Maintain vision at the entrances to your jungle early so you can track Shaco’s gank and invade routes. If you see Shaco committed to the other side of the map, use Lee Sin’s early jungle dueling advantage to steal camps or make a lane play. Save Lee Sin W Safeguard to escape when entering the enemy jungle.

Taliyah.combo: From an angle that avoids the field of rocks, hit Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, then chip away with a basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, and another basic attack. Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike deals more damage based on missing health, so use it late without letting its recast window expire. Slow Taliyah with Lee Sin E Cripple when she tries to escape. If your allies can follow up immediately, move behind Taliyah and kick her toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.
Taliyah.teamfight: When your allies can follow up immediately, get behind Taliyah and kick her toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. If your allies have not engaged yet, save Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to knock away opponents who dive your back line. Before engaging, plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike, and make sure you do not dash over Taliyah E Unraveled Earth's minefield.
Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. Lee Sin can use mobility spells to go around the minefield, so watch your approach path as well.
Taliyah.escape: When Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah W Seismic Shove are down, approach along a path that avoids the minefield. While Taliyah R Weaver's Wall is also down, close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and Q Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard, then use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Keep harassing Taliyah during the chase, since taking damage prevents her from using Taliyah R Weaver's Wall.
Taliyah.fight: Lee Sin's physical damage hits Taliyah, who has low armor, hard, so look for an opening to get close. Dodge Taliyah Q Threaded Volley to the side, and if Taliyah E Unraveled Earth has laid down a minefield, check the dash paths for Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike and Lee Sin W Safeguard first. Weave basic attacks between abilities to use Lee Sin P Flurry's attack speed and energy restoration.
Taliyah.laning: Use your early jungle advantage to disrupt the enemy jungler's route or make a lane play after your first two or three camps. When ganking, approach from beside the wave to make Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave easier to hit, since minions block it. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, suspect she may use Taliyah P Rock Surfing and Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to make a play in another lane, and retreat in advance.
Taliyah.phase: Use Lee Sin's strong early jungle dueling to get ahead in camps and lanes. Later, Lee Sin has a harder time killing opponents alone, so set up fights your allied damage dealers can follow up on.
Taliyah.watch: When Taliyah E Unraveled Earth lays down a minefield, Taliyah W Seismic Shove may follow soon, so move away from it. Avoid dashing across the minefield with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard, as you can be stunned. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley cannot change direction while being cast, so dodge to the side.

Graves.escape: Do not go in just because Graves E Quickdraw is down. When Graves R Collateral Damage is also down, close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard, then kick him toward your allies with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
Graves.laning: Use your early advantage to disrupt Graves’s route or gank a lane after your first two or three camps. Keep up pressure so Graves cannot stack Quickdraw, but save Lee Sin W Safeguard as an escape when entering the enemy jungle.
Graves.teamfight: When your allies can follow up immediately, get behind Graves and kick him toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage. If they cannot engage yet, save Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to knock back an enemy who dives in. After the fight, keep an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Graves.build: Graves deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Plated Steelcaps early help in skirmishes during the early and mid game.
Graves.combo: Hit Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave from an angle where minions and jungle monsters cannot block it, then chip away with basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, basic attack. Follow with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike to close the gap, and use the slow from Lee Sin E Cripple to stay on Graves if he escapes with Graves E Quickdraw.
Graves.fight: Trade while Graves is reloading after firing two shots. Use minions or an ally as cover to block Graves P New Destiny basic attacks, and weave Lee Sin basic attacks between abilities to restore energy and deal damage.
Graves.phase: Pressure Graves early, when Lee Sin is strong in jungle duels and counterjungling. Graves becomes a threat as he scales, and Lee Sin has trouble bursting him alone late, so set up plays for your allies.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates as soon as it hits terrain, so avoid fighting with your back to a wall or in a narrow jungle passage. If Graves W Smoke Screen traps you, your vision is blocked and you are slowed, so take the shortest route out of its area before re-engaging.

Ivern.laning: Ward Ivern’s jungle early and read his route to catch him when he comes to harvest camps he has seeded. Use Lee Sin’s early advantage in jungle duels, but save Lee Sin W Safeguard as an escape when entering deep into the enemy jungle. Do not pass by brush suddenly created by Ivern W Brushmaker without checking it.
Ivern.teamfight: Do not engage immediately on a target with Ivern E Triggerseed; watch for the shield to detonate. If Ivern R Daisy! is blocking the way, do not throw Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave at an enemy behind her. When your allies can follow up immediately, kick one enemy toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage; otherwise, knock back an enemy who has entered your back line.
Ivern.build: Build movement speed first so you can leave areas marked as dangerous. If allied follow-up on Ivern Q Rootcaller’s root is dangerous, prioritize tenacity. If you need to withstand Ivern’s magic damage, build magic resistance rather than armor.
Ivern.combo: When Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, hit Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and deal damage with basic attack → Lee Sin E Tempest → basic attack → Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Ivern.escape: The moment after you bait Ivern Q Rootcaller is your window to engage. Close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard, then you can kick Ivern toward your allies with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage once you are on him.
Ivern.fight: Immediately after Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave or Lee Sin W Safeguard. Weave in basic attacks between abilities to use Lee Sin P Flurry’s energy restoration, and close in with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike after chipping away at Ivern’s health. Delay your engage until the shield detonates if Ivern E Triggerseed is already on your target.
Ivern.phase: Early, Lee Sin is strong in jungle duels and counterjungling, so disrupt Ivern’s harvesting route to gain an advantage. Once Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage is available, look for a lane where your allies can follow up and kick Ivern toward them. Late, focus on moving enemies into positions where your allies can fight instead of chasing deep to kill them alone.
Ivern.watch: If Ivern Q Rootcaller roots you, Ivern’s ally can dash in, so avoid it by keeping minions or terrain between you and Ivern before he throws it. Target an enemy with Ivern E Triggerseed only after its shield detonates. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, move away to avoid the knock-up from its third consecutive attack.

Warwick.phase: Early on, Lee Sin is strong at jungle duels and invading, while Warwick clears the jungle slowly, so get ahead without giving up kills. Later, Lee Sin has a harder time bursting opponents alone, so focus on setting up fights for your allied damage dealers.
Warwick.teamfight: Warwick R Infinite Duress reaches farther when his movement speed is higher, so watch the opposite side of the objective pit and approaches without vision during objective standoffs. Use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to kick an opponent toward your allies only when they can follow up immediately. If your allies cannot engage yet, save R to knock away Warwick when he dives your back line, and plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Q Resonating Strike.
Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Q Jaws of the Beast, and R Infinite Duress. Warwick also deals physical damage with basic attacks, so armor is worth building too. Fit Executioner's Calling between core items to reduce his healing, then upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Warwick.combo: After hitting Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away with a basic attack → Lee Sin E Tempest → basic attack, then engage with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If your allies can follow up, get behind Warwick and kick him toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.
Warwick.escape: Do not engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down. Wait until Warwick R Infinite Duress is also down, then close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or W Safeguard, especially before R comes back up. It is better to re-engage after Warwick E Primal Howl's fear triggers.
Warwick.fight: Save your burst while Warwick E Primal Howl is active and resume the fight after its fear triggers. If you hit Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, weave basic attacks empowered by P Flurry between abilities to chip away, then use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike as a finisher; its damage increases based on missing health.
Warwick.laning: Use Lee Sin's early dueling advantage to disrupt Warwick's jungle route after your first two or three camps, or take camps and make a lane play while Warwick is occupied on the other side. When entering the jungle, save Lee Sin W Safeguard for your escape. If your health falls below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt will reveal you, so give up some farming and recall.
Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and triggers fear, so do not rush to use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. Back away, then re-engage after the fear triggers. Warwick R Infinite Duress is a suppressing dash that also provides healing; the higher Warwick's movement speed, the farther it reaches, so watch out for bushes without vision and areas beyond walls. When your health falls below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position.

Ekko.teamfight: Right after Ekko closes in with E Phase Dive, his mobility is down, so respond by kicking him toward your allies with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage. Engage only when your allies can follow up immediately. If they can’t engage yet, save Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to knock away an enemy who dives into your backline.
Ekko.build: To reduce the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ekko’s magic damage.
Ekko.combo: After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, lower Ekko’s health with a basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, then another basic attack, and finish with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If Ekko escapes with E Phase Dive, slow him with Lee Sin E Cripple. Right after Ekko closes in on Lee Sin, respond by kicking him toward your allies with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
Ekko.escape: The opening to engage is after Ekko W Parallel Convergence is down and before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back up. If Ekko E Phase Dive is down too, close the distance with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and Lee Sin W Safeguard, then use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage. Before engaging, plan an exit route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Ekko.fight: Avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s area and start a fight when Ekko R Chronobreak is down. Lee Sin should weave basic attacks between abilities to maintain energy, then close in with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike after lowering Ekko’s health. If Ekko escapes with E Phase Dive, use the slow from Lee Sin E Cripple to follow him.
Ekko.laning: After the first two or three camps, use Lee Sin’s dueling advantage to disrupt the enemy jungle path or gank. When ganking, approach beside the wave so you can land Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave without minions blocking it. Save Lee Sin W Safeguard to escape when entering the enemy jungle.
Ekko.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early jungle duels, so quickly disrupt the enemy’s path and build an advantage. In the late game, use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to isolate an enemy or knock away one who dives into your allies instead of trying to kill enemies alone.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave its area to avoid the stun and shield. Also move away from the path where Ekko Q Timewinder returns. If you see Ekko’s afterimage, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t chase recklessly even at low health.

Nidalee.teamfight: Track where Nidalee steps out to throw her spear, and use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to kick her toward your team when your allies can follow up immediately. If your allies can't engage yet, save Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to push away an opponent who dives in, and plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike before going in.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther it travels, so move out of its path when Nidalee steps out to throw it, and keep minions or your allied frontline between you and her. Also avoid Nidalee W Bushwhack in jungle entrances and the river so you don't start a fight with Hunt Mark applied. If you are hit by the spear, save Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage for the moment Nidalee closes in with Nidalee W Pounce.
Nidalee.build: Nidalee can sustain through fights with Nidalee E Primal Surge, so buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Nidalee's damage, but prioritize dodging Nidalee Q Javelin Toss.
Nidalee.combo: After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away in this order: basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, basic attack, then close in with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If Nidalee escapes with Nidalee W Pounce, slow her with Lee Sin E Cripple. If an ally can follow up, move behind Nidalee and kick her toward your ally with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.
Nidalee.escape: Nidalee has no crowd control, so the moment after you bait her into using Nidalee W Pounce is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will, and use the mobility you saved to escape if things get dangerous.
Nidalee.fight: Engage after dodging Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and Nidalee W Bushwhack. Weave basic attacks empowered by Lee Sin P Flurry between abilities, chip away at Nidalee's health, then use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Nidalee.laning: After the first two or three camps, disrupt Nidalee's jungle route, or take camps and intervene in lanes while Nidalee is occupied on the other side of the map. Check for traps in jungle entrances and the river with a Control Ward or Lee Sin E Tempest, and keep Lee Sin W Safeguard available to escape when going deep into the enemy jungle.
Nidalee.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early jungle duels, so turn your advantage after the first two or three camps into a kill or disrupted routes. In the late game, instead of trying to catch an opponent alone, use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to send an enemy toward your allies or push away an opponent who has reached your back line.

Rengar.teamfight: Keep your backline behind your frontline and be ready to counter Rengar’s engage. After Rengar W Battle Roar is down, use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to kick him toward your team or away from your backline. Before engaging, plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator leaps from brush and builds Ferocity, so avoid paths beside brush when Rengar is out of sight. Rengar E Bola Strike roots when Ferocity is full, so dodge it, then reposition with Lee Sin W Safeguard. When Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is active, don’t roam alone while injured; stay with your team.
Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar’s main damage. To reduce the healing from Rengar W Battle Roar, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Rengar.combo: Fight in this order: Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave → basic attack → Lee Sin E Tempest → basic attack → Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If Rengar has used Rengar W Battle Roar, kick him toward your team with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage. Slow him with Lee Sin E Cripple if he tries to escape.
Rengar.escape: Dodge Rengar E Bola Strike and engage when Rengar’s Ferocity bar is empty. If Rengar W Battle Roar is also down, close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and Lee Sin W Safeguard, then use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
Rengar.fight: Start trades when Rengar’s Ferocity bar is empty. After confirming Rengar W Battle Roar is down, use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage and follow up with damage. Even if Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave hits, don’t immediately use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike; chip away with basic attacks and Lee Sin E Tempest, then use it to finish him.
Rengar.laning: Lee Sin is strong in early jungle duels, so look for a chance to disrupt Rengar’s route after your first two or three camps. Avoid paths beside brush and use a Control Ward to reveal brush. Keep Lee Sin W Safeguard available to escape when entering the enemy jungle.
Rengar.phase: Use Lee Sin’s strong early jungle dueling to disrupt Rengar’s route and gain an advantage. Later, instead of trying to kill Rengar alone, help your carries by kicking him away with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage when he engages.

Udyr.laning: After clearing your first two or three camps, track Udyr’s route and look for a chance to meet him in the jungle or gank a lane. Use vision at jungle entrances and key routes to track his ganks, and make sure your lanes don’t push forward while Udyr is out of sight. Save Lee Sin W Safeguard to escape when entering the enemy jungle.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t try to force a kill on Udyr while he is tanky from defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle. If your team can follow up immediately, use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to send an enemy toward them; otherwise, use it to knock away Udyr when he dives in. Before engaging, plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
Udyr.combo: After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away with a basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, and another basic attack, then close in with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If Udyr escapes with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, slow him with Lee Sin E Cripple. To kick Udyr toward your team, move behind him and use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage, making sure the Awakened effect of Udyr E Blazing Stampede has ended.
Udyr.escape: The opening to engage with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will comes right after you bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If Udyr’s stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede has already hit once, it can’t immediately affect the same target again; use that window to fight back or escape. After the Awakened effect of Udyr E Blazing Stampede ends, lock him down with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
Udyr.fight: After baiting out Udyr E Blazing Stampede, close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will. When Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone, press the attack with basic attacks mixed in, then use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike after he has lost more health. Use Lee Sin E Cripple after Udyr E Blazing Stampede to follow him.
Udyr.phase: Early on, Lee Sin is strong in jungle duels, so look for a chance to disrupt Udyr’s route after your first two or three camps. In the mid game, once Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage is available, continue making lane plays by kicking Udyr toward your team. Later, Lee Sin has trouble bursting enemies alone, so set up fights where your team can deal damage.
Udyr.build: Buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder to reduce the healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle. Prioritize armor for resistances, but keep in mind that armor alone can't block both the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm and the two damage types from Udyr Q Wilding Claw.
Udyr.watch: Watch out for the stun on Udyr's first attack right after he activates Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so don't fight him for long. During the awakened effect of Udyr E Blazing Stampede, immobilizing effects don't work, so use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage after the awakening ends.

Jax.teamfight: If Jax turns on Jax E Counter Strike and jumps in, do not bunch up around him; keep your distance until the area stun ends. Immediately afterward, use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to knock Jax away from your back line or kick him toward your allies to set up focused damage. Only engage deep when your allies can follow up immediately, and plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Q Resonating Strike beforehand.
Jax.build: For your first purchase, prioritize an item that can suppress Jax’s basic attacks and attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that greatly increase health alone.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, attack in this order: Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave → basic attack → Lee Sin E Tempest → basic attack → Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. Use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike after Jax’s health is chipped down, but do not let its recast window expire.
Jax.escape: The window to engage is just after the stun from Jax E Counter Strike ends and Jax Q Leap Strike is also down. Close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard, then kick Jax toward your allies with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage. If Jax E Counter Strike is still active, save Lee Sin W Safeguard to create distance.
Jax.fight: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, do not use basic attacks; create distance to avoid the stun. After Counter Strike ends, hit Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and weave in basic attacks between abilities to restore energy as you fight. If Jax Q Leap Strike is also down, it is an opportunity to close the gap with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Q Resonating Strike.
Jax.laning: Use Lee Sin’s early jungle advantage to gank Jax’s lane, but decide first whether to save Lee Sin W Safeguard as an escape when you engage.
Jax.phase: In the mid game, look for a setup to kick Jax toward your allies with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage. Late, rather than trying to kill Jax alone, peel him away so your allied damage dealers can attack.
Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, your basic attacks are negated, and its recast damage and area stun are dangerous, so stop attacking and move outside its range. Jax can follow you with Jax Q Leap Strike, so save Lee Sin W Safeguard to create distance.

XinZhao.teamfight: Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's knockback can split your formation, so do not stand too close to your allies. If Xin Zhao dives your back line, knock him away with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage, then attack together after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's immunity ends. Before diving the enemy back line, make sure your allies can follow up immediately and plan an escape route with Lee Sin W Safeguard or Q Resonating Strike.
XinZhao.build: Prioritize armor against Xin Zhao's main damage. Buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder to reduce healing from Xin Zhao P Determination.
XinZhao.combo: After hitting Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away with a basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, and another basic attack, then engage with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If Xin Zhao tries to escape with E Audacious Charge, use Lee Sin E Cripple's slow. If your allies can follow up, move behind Xin Zhao and kick him toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.
XinZhao.escape: Right after Xin Zhao uses E Audacious Charge is your chance to engage with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and Q Resonating Strike or W Safeguard. If you have been hit by two empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, use Lee Sin W Safeguard to get away before the third attack. To prevent Xin Zhao from escaping, force him into a position with no target behind him for E Audacious Charge.
XinZhao.fight: Close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and W Safeguard right after Xin Zhao uses E Audacious Charge. Weave basic attacks between abilities to use Lee Sin P Flurry, then use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike after chipping away at his health. When Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, create distance and wait out the immunity before fighting again.
XinZhao.laning: Use Lee Sin's early dueling advantage to disrupt Xin Zhao's route or make a lane play after your first two or three jungle camps. Dodge Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to the side to reduce his chance to dash in, and hit Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave from an angle that avoids minions. When entering the enemy jungle, save Lee Sin W Safeguard for your escape.
XinZhao.phase: Early on, Lee Sin is strong at jungle duels and invading, so disrupt Xin Zhao's route to get ahead. In the mid game, once Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage is available, kick an enemy toward your allies in a lane where they can follow up. Later, Lee Sin's share of the damage falls, so target the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends or knock Xin Zhao away from your allies when he dives them.
XinZhao.watch: Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike's third basic attack knocks you up, so if you have been hit by two empowered attacks, use Lee Sin W Safeguard to get out of range. Dodge the rear thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving to the side. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, damage from outside his spear's range does not affect him, so wait for the immunity to end.

Evelynn.build: Get a Control Ward early, and prioritize magic resistance against Evelynn’s main damage. If you need to reduce healing from Evelynn P Demon Shade, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Evelynn E Whiplash deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on an option that only adds a large amount of health.
Evelynn.combo: Attack in this order: Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave → basic attack → Lee Sin E Tempest → basic attack → Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If Evelynn escapes with E Whiplash, use the slow from Lee Sin E Cripple to follow her. If your allies can follow up, move behind Evelynn and kick her toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
Evelynn.escape: Don’t engage while the mark from Evelynn W Allure is building; back away. If only Evelynn E Whiplash is down, she can still escape with Evelynn R Last Caress, so close the distance with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back up. Once close, use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage to stop her escape.
Evelynn.fight: After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, lower the target’s health with basic attacks and Lee Sin E Tempest, then use Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike close to the finish, since it deals more damage based on the target’s missing health. Weave basic attacks between abilities to use Lee Sin P Flurry’s attack speed increase.
