Evelynn.laning: Place a ward beside the jungle camps where Evelynn starts fights, and alert your allies immediately if you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure. When invading, save Lee Sin W Safeguard so you can get out.
Evelynn.phase: In the mid game, look for fights where you can kick Evelynn toward your allies with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage. In the late game, Lee Sin has trouble killing enemies alone, so focus on setting up fights for your allied damage dealers.
Evelynn.teamfight: Evelynn targets backline damage dealers, so watch for her engage in areas where your allies have vision. Keep Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage ready, then knock Evelynn away when she goes in to protect your allied damage dealers. Go behind Evelynn and kick her toward your allies only when they can follow up immediately.
Evelynn.watch: When you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, back away before the charm completes. Evelynn R Last Caress deals much more damage when your health is low, so don’t stay in areas without vision.

Fiddlesticks.build: To reduce healing from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Fiddlesticks’ damage.
Fiddlesticks.combo: After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, lower Fiddlesticks’ health with a basic attack → Lee Sin E Tempest → basic attack, then follow him with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If you need to interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest’s channel, use Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage then.
Fiddlesticks.fight: Weave basic attacks between abilities, then finish Fiddlesticks with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike after his health has been reduced. When Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest starts, interrupt the channel with the Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage you saved.
Fiddlesticks.laning: After the first two or three camps, disrupt Fiddlesticks’ path or gank to use Lee Sin’s early dueling advantage. Save Lee Sin W Safeguard to escape when entering the jungle. Keep vision in the brushes behind lanes during gank timings, and don’t pass a stationary Fiddlesticks P A Harmless Scarecrow without checking it.
Fiddlesticks.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early jungle duels, so pressure Fiddlesticks to build an advantage. In the late game, Lee Sin has trouble killing enemies alone, so set up fights for your allied damage dealers.
Fiddlesticks.escape: The window to engage is while Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, his means of movement, is down. If you get hit by Fiddlesticks Q Terrify or the silence from Fiddlesticks E Reap, it becomes difficult to respond, so secure vision before engaging. Close in with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will, and decide on an escape route in advance in case of danger.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, Fiddlesticks E Reap, and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm are area-of-effect abilities, so spread out from allies and don't group up in narrow terrain. If you see Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channeling, interrupt it with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage; if it has already gone off, move out of range. Kick Fiddlesticks toward your allies only when they can follow up immediately.
Fiddlesticks.watch: If Fiddlesticks has been out of sight for a long time, assume he may be setting up Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm in a bush. If you see him channeling, interrupt him with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage; if you can't, move out of range. Fiddlesticks can fear you with abilities while unseen, so watch out for bushes without vision and narrow passages.

JarvanIV.combo: After hitting Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away with basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, basic attack, then close in with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike.
JarvanIV.escape: Then close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and Q Resonating Strike, or W Safeguard, and hold them with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
JarvanIV.fight: After hitting Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away with basic attacks and Lee Sin E Tempest, then finish with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike, which grows stronger based on the target’s missing health.
JarvanIV.laning: Save Lee Sin W Safeguard as an escape when entering the enemy jungle.
JarvanIV.teamfight: When your allies can follow up immediately, kick one enemy toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.

MonkeyKing.build: To reduce the healing from Wukong P Stone Skin, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Build armor first against Wukong's primary damage, but keep in mind that armor doesn't mitigate the magic damage from Wukong E Nimbus Strike. Wukong R Cyclone deals damage based on maximum health, so consider reducing attack speed instead of relying on health alone.
MonkeyKing.combo: After landing Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away with a basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, then another basic attack, and close in with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. If Wukong escapes with Wukong W Warrior Trickster or Wukong E Nimbus Strike, use the slow from Lee Sin E Cripple then. When using Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage, first line up the direction to kick Wukong toward your allies.
MonkeyKing.escape: The opportunity to engage is when Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, before it returns. If Wukong E Nimbus Strike is also down, close the gap with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard, and keep Wukong in place for your allies with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Right after Wukong R Cyclone is down, you can force an objective or a fight.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong P Stone Skin builds armor and healing the longer the fight goes on, so deal damage briefly and back off. Make use of Lee Sin P Flurry by weaving basic attacks between abilities, then finish with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike after you have reduced Wukong's health. Engage while Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, but check whether Wukong E Nimbus Strike is still available.
MonkeyKing.laning: Use Lee Sin's early dueling advantage to plan a route that disrupts Wukong's path or intervenes in a lane after the first two or three camps. If you meet Wukong in the jungle, avoid a long duel, and keep Lee Sin W Safeguard available to escape when going deep. Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave is blocked by minions and jungle monsters, so approach ganks from the side of the wave to get a clear angle.
MonkeyKing.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early jungle duels, so gain an advantage through short fights and disrupting Wukong's route. In the late game, Lee Sin has a hard time taking down opponents alone, so focus on setting up opportunities for your stronger allies to attack.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: If your allies can't engage yet, save Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to push away an engaging Wukong, and use Lee Sin W Safeguard to set up an escape route.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted and can't be dodged while you're in range; if Wukong follows it with Wukong Q Crushing Blow, your armor is reduced. When Wukong W Warrior Trickster appears, don't use abilities on the stationary clone; watch which way the real Wukong goes.

Zac.build: Buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder to reduce Zac's healing. Build magic resistance rather than armor against the damage from Zac Q Stretching Strikes, W Unstable Matter, and E Elastic Slingshot.
Zac.combo: After hitting Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, chip away with a basic attack, Lee Sin E Tempest, and another basic attack, then engage with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike. After Zac escapes with E Elastic Slingshot, use Lee Sin E Cripple's slow to chase. If your allies can follow up, move behind Zac and kick him toward them with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.
Zac.escape: Right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down is Lee Sin's window to engage. If you see Zac charging E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall, you can interrupt him with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage and fight. Plan an escape route before using both Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave and W Safeguard to engage.
Zac.fight: Right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, engage with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or W Safeguard / Iron Will. Weave basic attacks between abilities to use Lee Sin P Flurry, and finish with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike after chipping away at Zac's health. Step on the blobs Zac leaves behind to prevent him from healing.
Zac.laning: Disrupt Zac's route after your first two or three camps, or steal camps and make a lane play while Zac is occupied on the other side. When entering Zac's jungle, save Lee Sin W Safeguard for your escape. When ganking, aim Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave from the side to avoid minions.
Zac.phase: Lee Sin is strong at early jungle duels and invading, so disrupt Zac's route and get ahead while you can. Later, Lee Sin has a harder time bursting opponents alone, so focus on setting up fights that favor your allies.
Zac.teamfight: Before a fight, check whether Zac P Cell Division's revival is available. If Zac engages with E Elastic Slingshot, interrupt him with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage or knock him away from your allies, then create distance to avoid Zac W Unstable Matter's damage. If Zac splits apart, finish the pieces with Lee Sin E Tempest's area damage when they get close together.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot charges before dashing and knocking you up, so if you see him charging behind a wall, avoid his landing spot or interrupt him with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Zac Q Stretching Strikes slows and knocks you up; if it catches you, you are more likely to take damage from Zac W Unstable Matter, which deals damage based on maximum health, so create distance.
